profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Digi-Key Electronics at Digi-Key Electronics
profile.summary: Highly creative, hard-working, and high-energy multicultural Computer Science graduate seeking a career in computer science applications. Excellent problem solving, programming, and social skills with a keen interest in furthering knowledge in all computer science related areas.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Team Lead for Agile team responsible for maintaining and actively supporting a large and fundamental part of a Shipping Monolith System used to get packages shipped out. Utilizing C++, C#, C, SQL, Docker, and Azure DevOps source control; which has significantly reduced the level of production support incidents while the system continues to grow and evolve.
Engaged in upgrading, maintaining, and system integrating various Shipping Carrier tools including FedEx, DHL, UPS, USPS, and Connect Ship software and servers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for maintaining and actively supporting a large and
fundamental part of a Shipping Monolith System used to get packages
shipped out. Utilizing C++, C#, C, SQL, Docker, and Azure DevOps source
control; which has significantly reduced the level of production support

Collaborating in an Agile SCRUM team environment to analyze and engage in

work processes to provide 24/7 support, research, overhaul, or upgrade
them to modern enterprise and scalable quality .NET Services. All to meet
the needs of customers and other employees.

positions.title: Contract Software Developer at Digi-Key Electronics
positions.description: Full Time contract work at Digikey Electronics through the HatchGroup.

positions.title: Technical Aide
positions.description: Responsible for learning any new technologies and projects assigned. These include: Learning and becoming primary developer on a Blockchain project involving Ethereum’s BlockChain technology and Microsoft Azure private systems; being part of a research team working with BlockChain that successfully developed at least one patent, primary developer for a 24 Hour Blockchain hackathon representing 3M in St. Louis; and becoming part of one of the first SCRUM research teams in 3M in which we prototyped new IOT products for 3M as the primary mobile application, Object Oriented, and machine learning programmer
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · BlockChain · Microsoft Azure · Android Development · Bluetooth Low Energy · Python · SCRUM · Java · Raspberry Pi · C# · Web Development · Internet of Things · Ethereum · Project Management · HTML · C · JavaScript

positions.title: Teacher of "Minecraft Modding with Java Programming"​
positions.description: Designed, implemented, and documented a Minecraft video game Modification and wrote curriculum to teach Minecraft Modding with Java to elementary and middle school students. Curriculum and Mod was used by all teachers corporate-wide. Maintained computer equipment to be used during camps. Taught Java programming to children 6-15.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Java · Web Development · Project Management · JavaScript

positions.title: Teacher of "Minecraft Modding with Java Programming"
positions.description: Created a teaching curriculum, including Java programming modifications to popular video game Minecraft. Thenused the curriculum to teach “Minecraft Modding with Java” to elementary and middle school students. Curriculum and materials were used by all teachers corporate-wide. Maintained computer equipment to be used during camps. Taught Java programming to children 7-13.
positions.insights: Skills: Android Development · Java · Web Development · Project Management · JavaScript
